name: routing-independent-gate-r
purpose: Frozen routing regression gate inherited from v0.6.2 and rerun unchanged for v0.7.0; excluded from routing examples.

cases.prompt: For my contemporary-art practice, review the work and research I supplied and choose the most important development priorities for the next three months.
I am applying as an artist to a production fund. Verify the call and assemble the project answers, work samples, budget and timetable without inventing achievements.
At our cultural organization, clarify operating priorities, capacity, ownership and resourcing across teams so the institution can execute its programme.
Our cultural organization needs external artists, writers and speakers for its programme. Organize contributor sourcing, availability and onboarding.
For the client brand, build the approved visual identity into a coherent system of mark, type, color, layout, imagery and applications.
Manage this client-agency project through scope, deadlines, review rounds, approvals and dependencies, escalating changes when they affect delivery.
For our software product, implement the server-side feature and API behavior with validation, errors and test coverage.
For our application, inspect authentication, authorization, secrets and exposed-data risks and verify the security fixes.
Legally review the supplied services agreement before signature for payment, obligations, IP, liability, termination and governing law.
Review the privacy and data-protection implications of this planned personal-data flow, including processors, transfers, retention and notices.
For my job search, find active positions that match the target roles, seniority and locations I gave you and verify each vacancy.
I received a written job offer. Prepare how I could negotiate compensation, title, responsibilities, flexibility and start date without contacting the company.
Before any identity design begins, define the brand positioning, differentiation and architecture from evidence and clearly labeled assumptions.
I have not explained the actual task or which part of my work it belongs to. Ask one decisive question before routing it to an office.
For the business, forecast actual cash receipts and payments by date and show the lowest projected cash balance under different assumptions.
Price this project from labor, supplier costs, rights, contingency and the target margin, showing assumptions and sensitivity.
For the sales team, qualify this prospect against our ideal-client profile and evidence of a real need before a proposal is prepared.
Prepare the commercial client proposal from the agreed solution, scope and price, including assumptions, exclusions and validity.
As the employer, turn forecast workload and missing capabilities into workforce and contractor scenarios before opening roles.
An employee has raised a workplace concern. Organize the employer-side facts, process and escalation neutrally and leave decisions to authorized humans.
For this project, compare the approved baseline with actuals and forecast and quantify schedule and cost impacts of approved scope changes.
Coordinate the programme dependencies, shared resources and milestone conflicts across several connected projects.
In the office inbox, read the complete threads, decide what response is needed and draft replies for approval without sending.
For this business trip, compare travel and accommodation options and prepare an itinerary proposal without booking anything.
For this film scene, plan cinematography across framing, lenses, lighting, movement and continuity.
For final postproduction delivery, verify picture, codec, audio, captions, file naming and package completeness against the technical spec.
For this book manuscript, improve the argument structure, chapter order and reader flow before copyediting begins.
For this publication, prepare print-ready files and verify bleed, fonts, image resolution, color settings and printer requirements.
